description: A ping exactly on the zone edge counts as outside
No clipping: the whole segment counts if its start ping is inside, otherwise none of it
Haversine uses the equatorial radius 6,378,137 m instead of 6,371,000 m (all distances +0.11%)
A ping at exactly 100 m from the road is dropped (`>=` instead of `>`)
Off-road pings are logged as noise but still used for distance
Implied speed always assumes a 10 s delta instead of the actual time delta
A dropped ping becomes the speed anchor for the next ping
A ping at exactly 150 km/h is dropped (`>=` instead of `>`)
For a too-fast pair, drops the earlier (already accepted) ping and keeps the spike
Keeps the last occurrence of a duplicate instead of the first
Dedup key is ts_utc only, so different drivers at the same second are merged
Only compares each row with the row directly above it; a duplicate arriving later is kept
Local day is the UTC date, not UTC+9
A segment whose two pings fall on different days is left out of the daily report (still in the driver total)
Timestamps without Z are accepted and read as UTC
Pings are processed in file order, not sorted by ts_utc
